title: Sixth 100 medium-machine candidates: facsimile headword/boundary review
provenance_note: AI-assisted visual collation against the Steffel 1809 facsimile for the sixth medium-confidence cohort in deterministic source order. The facsimile is authoritative; the preserved OCR is a secondary aid. Review resolves headword presence, article-start boundary, exact printed page and visible OCR headword errors. It is not independent human/philological or linguistic validation.
